lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai subhaai sahaj gun gaaeeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaai vigasai sadaa anadin jaa aap saache bhaavae ||
lines.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaar haumai tajai maaiaa sahaj naam samaavae ||
lines.translation: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karataa kare soee aap dei ta paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar saachaa nehu poore satigurai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tis sevee din raat mai kade na veesarai jeeu ||
lines.translation: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kade na visaaree anadin samhaaree jaa naam laee taa jeevaa ||
lines.translation: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravanee sunee ta ihu man tripatai guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||
lines.translation: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele anadin bibek budh bicharai ||
lines.translation: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar saachaa nehu poore satigurai ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat milai vadabhaag taa har ras aavae jeeu ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin rahai liv laai ta sahaj samaavae jeeu ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadaa ateet bairaagee ||
lines.translation: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat sobhaa jag a(n)tar raam naam liv laagee ||
lines.translation: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog duhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare s bhaavae ||
lines.translation: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat milai vadabhaag taa har ras aavae jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh hoi manamukh jam johiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haai haai kare din raat maaiaa dukh mohiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa dukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaavae ||
lines.translation: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, "Mine, mine!".

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh dei tis chetai naahee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavae ||
lines.translation: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maaiaa dhohiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh hoi manamukh jam johiaa jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaai mahal har paaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa rahai kar joR prabh man bhaaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam ma(n)n sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin japat rahai din raatee sahaje naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo naam milee vadiaaee naanak naam man bhaavae ||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaai mahal har paavae jeeu ||5||1||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||
